-- Add new columns for hybrid workflow
ALTER TABLE signed_documents 
  ADD COLUMN uploaded_s3_key VARCHAR(1000) AFTER s3_url,
  ADD COLUMN uploaded_s3_url TEXT AFTER uploaded_s3_key;

-- Make s3_key and s3_url nullable (for documents awaiting HelloDoc ID)
ALTER TABLE signed_documents 
  MODIFY COLUMN s3_key VARCHAR(1000) NULL,
  MODIFY COLUMN s3_url TEXT NULL;

-- Add new status value and update default
ALTER TABLE signed_documents 
  MODIFY COLUMN status ENUM('pending', 'awaiting_hellodoc_id', 'signed', 'rejected', 'expired') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'awaiting_hellodoc_id';

-- Make sentAt nullable (since it's set when sent from HelloDoc)
ALTER TABLE signed_documents 
  MODIFY COLUMN sent_at TIMESTAMP NULL;
